verdict.rationale: Datalab's core output formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON) are inherently open and portable rather than locked into a proprietary format, and the underlying Marker/Surya/Chandra models are stated to be free and open source, with on-prem/Enterprise deployment (Helm chart, air-gapped) letting a user fully exit the hosted service and run everything themselves. However, there's no explicit documentation of a one-click 'export all my account data' (pipelines, extraction history, billing records, team settings) feature beyond checkpoints/webhooks, so full data portability of platform-side metadata is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit account/history data export tooling, independent verification of open-source licensing terms for the models.
